# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_002_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 2

**1** Jesus said: "Let the one who seeks not stop seeking until he finds.

**2** And when he finds, he will be troubled.

**3** When he is troubled, he will marvel.

**4** And he will reign over all."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- Four-stage spiritual progression: seeking → finding → being troubled → marveling → reigning
- "Not stop seeking" — the prohibition on ceasing preserves the urgency; seeking is an active discipline
- "Troubled" (*šōrp*) — deliberate preservation of the disturbing middle stage; finding is not immediately comfortable
- "Marvel" — the progression through disturbance to wonder is psychologically precise
- "Reign over all" — eschatological sovereignty; the seeker becomes a king/queen
- Note: P.Oxy 654 adds a fifth stage — "and having reigned, he will rest" — absent from the Coptic
